normalized.description: The purpose of this activity is to study in detail the system and subsystem requirements for a planetary defence mission that aims at building a space-based infrared telescope dedicated to detection and characterisation of Near-Earth Objects (NEOs) that approach from the direction of the Sun. The mission builds on extensive work done by the Agency and European industry between 2022 and 2026. The target is to reach a consolidated mission and satellite architecture, finalize the major trade-offs and generate system and subsystem level requirements. In particular, the study will provide a consolidated spacecraft design and payload interface supported by detailed analyses and prepare the implementation phase including the establishment of the spacecraft development plan, preparation activities for Phase B2/C/D/E1 procurement, and cost estimates. The study will be carried out in two phases: one phase of 18months with a goal of reaching the objectives of an SRR-level review, and an additional optional 6-months phase that will aim at ingesting additional data fed by the Agency on the payloads into the system level design.
